notes: Machine-readable twin of INSTALL.md. Keep both in sync. status values: documented = commands taken from the repo README; unverified = taken from vendor docs or search results, never run on the host; planned = not available yet.

after_install.description: dist/ folders are build output and are not in git, so every route that installs from the repository must build once.
after_install.locate_plugin_root: The folder that contains scripts/bootstrap.mjs and .mcp.json. Search for it; do not guess.

workbuddy.label: WorkBuddy
steps: add the GitHub repository as a plugin marketplace through the WorkBuddy interface
workbuddy.fallback: Add the two MCP servers from .mcp.json to ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json (no leading dot before workbuddy), using absolute paths.

claude-desktop.label: Claude Desktop
claude-desktop.note: A one-click .mcpb bundle is planned. No tested route exists yet.
